caption:
Decoded by Galvor, Issue #14: Plenty of Data, No Memory. Where Your Ad Learnings Go When the Agency Leaves

Most D2C brands can pull two years of ad data in a minute and still can't say what they learned from it. The numbers stay in the account; the reasons live in people's heads and leave with them. This issue looks at why learning loops break at the handover, and what a brand memory has to hold to survive one.

Subscribe to get it every Wednesday.
notes: Outline planned 18 Nov 2026 (why now: January is when agency contracts renew or change and new performance hires start; it is also the third issue of the learning-loop month, after #12 (the fortnightly cycle) and #13 (the budget case to finance), so this one covers what the loop has to remember between cycles.). Posted from the Galvor page. Write with Decoded → Draft with AI, then fill every [DATA NEEDED].
